_comment: Recorded timings for the code generation speedup notebooks, used when a docs
build has no coding-agent backend (FOMTOOLS_CODEGEN_AGENT != 1) and therefore
cannot generate, verify and time a solver itself.
Timings AND ratios are both stored verbatim as published, and are rendered
as-is rather than recomputed. The published ratios were computed from full-
precision timings, while the published timings are rounded to 3 decimals, so
re-deriving a ratio from the stored timings does NOT reproduce it (e.g. lasso
7.335/1.546 = 4.74, but the recorded ratio is 4.75). The lost precision is not
recoverable, so these rows are treated as a record to reproduce exactly, which
also keeps every notebook page consistent with speedup_results.md.
To refresh: run each notebook with FOMTOOLS_CODEGEN_AGENT=1 on the benchmark
machine and copy the reported timings here, updating provenance below.

_provenance_note: hardware and compiler are null because they were never recorded alongside
the original measurements and cannot be recovered from the repository.
Whoever re-runs the benchmark should fill them in.
